title: The "Secret" Open-Source Cheat Code Replacing Claude Code #opencode  #claudecode  #codex
description:
You do not need to pay twenty dollars a month for Claude Code because OpenCode is the perfect alternative.
 
• OpenCode starts at only five dollars and gives you access to twelve powerful models.
• You can use top tier models like Kimi, Qwen 3.6 Plus, Minimax, and DeepSeek V4 Flash all in one place.
• Many developers find that large subscriptions are too expensive for the restrictive limits they offer.
• OpenCode fixes this by giving you over 31,000 requests every five hours on DeepSeek V4 Flash.
• You also get over 16,000 requests per month on Qwen 3.6 Plus for complex coding tasks.
• It is the perfect open source alternative if twenty dollars a month feels too expensive for your workflow.
